description: Displays web content in an editor panel using an embedded iframe.
configuration.focusLockIndicator.enabled: Enable/disable the floating indicator that shows when focused in the AI browser.
configuration.useIntegratedBrowser.descr: Open URLs in VS Code's built-in browser rather than the AI Browser webview panel. The built-in browser is what the element-picker commands attach to, and it supports clipboard shortcuts, find in page and DevTools that the panel cannot. Turn it off only if you specifically want the panel.
configuration.searchEngine.description: Search engine used when the address bar input is a search term rather than a URL. Set to 'none' to disable address bar search.
